text:
alice: Starting a coordinated wave for runtime v2.3.0 / api v1.9.2 / console v5.1.0 / router v3.4.1. ETA 03:00 UTC. tagging owners: @ben @carla @dan
ben: Ack. Can we pin router to a compatibility lock while console migration runs? If runtime kernel change fails we want fast fallback.
carla: +1. Proposal: staged traffic 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%, 15m observation per step.
dan: What are our explicit rollback triggers? CPU > 80%? 5xx > 0.5%? tail latency jumps?
alice: Propose triggers: absolute 5xx delta >0.4% OR p95 latency +300ms OR new exception class in console logs. If any hit, rollback that service.
carla: Also add behavioral regression: if API eval suite mismatch >1% we auto-fallback to previous model/version.
ben: FYI I'll request deploy-bot schedule: ` /deploy wave --time 03:00 --services runtime,api,router,console --stagger 10m `
deploy-bot: DeployBot: queued wave 1731239876. Phases: runtime -> api -> router -> console. Canary: 4 pods, duration 15m. Pins: router=3.4.1-lock.
alice: I'll run preflight now: no schema migrations, feature flags off, canary secrets set in KMS.
dan: I'll add temp tracing hooks and a KV cache miss-rate alert for the window.
carla: Release notes: no breaking API changes, but kernel op reorder may affect p95. Will call out in notes.
ben: Rollback ordering suggestion: rollback runtime first, then router, then console (to restore request path). If memory climbs, rollback immediately.
alice: Adding a manual `abort` override to the deploy-bot runbook and leaving a 30m cushion after 100% before closing the window. :thumbsup:
dan: Confirmed: no DB migrations in this wave.
carla: Running staging load test at 1.5x for 30m, queued.
deploy-bot: DeployBot: canary started on runtime cluster-us-east-1 at 03:00:10. Canary id=c-7891. Notifying #eng-sre.
alice: Noted. Everyone on standby. Ben, call out if you see packet drops.
ben: Small p95 blip +40ms at 03:07, not breaching thresholds yet. Watching.
carla: Canary metrics look stable. Moving to api phase in ~5m.
deploy-bot: DeployBot: api rollout started. pinned api=1.9.2-safe. Phasing to 10% traffic.
dan: ALERT: runtime p95 crossed +300ms at 03:23 and 5xx climbed to 0.9% (from 0.2%) — hitting our configured threshold.
alice: Initiating rollback of runtime now. ` /rollback canary c-7891 `
deploy-bot: DeployBot: rollback initiated for canary c-7891. Rolling runtime back to v2.2.8. Progress: 40%...
ben: Hold router/console phases. Do not advance.
carla: Aborting console rollout and opening an incident note + postmortem doc.
deploy-bot: DeployBot: runtime rollback complete. Canary c-7891 closed. All services at pre-wave versions.
alice: Thanks. Good catch. We'll dig into kernel memory + KV cache interaction. Re-schedule after fixes.
dan: Logs archived: s3://redwood-logs/releases/1731239876/runtime-rollback/ — includes heap profiles and perf traces.
ben: I'll update release notes with rollback summary, triggers that fired, and next steps. Closing the wave for now. Good work all.
